summary: Coordinate destination plans, visitor-flow responses and sustainability reporting. Explore this five-day intermediate destination management course.
lede: Destination management coordinates tourism planning and delivery across a place. The course is for destination managers, tourism planners and partnership leads who need to align services, stakeholders and community priorities. It develops practical skills in building indicator baselines, assessing visitor pressure, and turning sustainability priorities into action plans and progress scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate tourism activity across a destination and need practical ways to align services, stakeholders, sustainability priorities and reporting.
prerequisites: Relevant experience in tourism, destination operations, tourism planning or stakeholder coordination is recommended. No coding or programming is required; working familiarity with spreadsheets will support the indicator and scorecard exercises.
